scenes.visual_description: A rustic hotel bedroom in 19th-century Transylvania. Heavy timber beams cross the ceiling above white plaster walls adorned with dried herbs and a wooden crucifix. A rugged mountain road winding through the Carpathian landscape at sunset. Green sloping hills are covered in orchards of white fruit blossoms. In the background, jagged pine-covered peaks turn deep purple and blue against a fading pink sky. The lighting is the golden-hour glow of early evening.

A dark, narrow mountain pass shrouded in gloom and mist. Towering jagged rocks and dense pine forests loom on either side, creating a tunnel-like effect. The scene is lit only by moonlight breaking through storm clouds and the faint glow of carriage lamps on snow-dusted ground.

scenes.location_header: INT. CASTLE DRACULA - HALL AND DINING ROOM
scenes.visual_description: Ancient Transylvanian castle interior at night. A massive stone hall with a great iron-studded door leads into a dining room warmed by a roaring log fire. Antique silver lamps cast long, quivering shadows against stone walls. A table is spread for supper with gold service. Medieval architecture, gloomy but grand, with no mirrors visible.

A vast library in the castle, walls lined with shelves of English books and bound magazines. A table in the center is littered with papers and periodicals. Lit by oil lamps, the room has a scholarly but ancient feel, with heavy curtains and comfortable but old furniture. No mirrors.

A large, well-appointed bedroom in the castle. A great bed with heavy hangings dominates the room. A log fire burns in a wide stone hearth. A window looks out over a stone precipice. The room is comfortable but isolated, with a small octagonal antechamber.

A symbolic representation of the book's themes.

A gloomy Victorian study at night, lit by a single green-shaded desk lamp. Walls are lined with dark medical texts and case files. In the foreground, a mahogany desk holds a phonograph with wax cylinders and scattered newspapers. Clinical, shadowy, and claustrophobic atmosphere with deep corners.

A quiet, shady spot in a London park. A wooden bench sits beneath large plane trees shedding their leaves. The grass is dappled with sunlight. In the distance, the noise of the city is a muffled hum. Peaceful and secluded.

The interior of a grand stone burial vault. Damp stone walls are lined with shelves holding leaden and wood coffins. The air is thick with dust and the smell of death. Rusty iron grilles and tarnished brass plates catch the flicker of lantern light. Oppressive, heavy, and silent.

A children's ward in a London hospital, late Victorian era. Rows of iron cots with white linens line the walls. Large sash windows let in pale afternoon light. A nurse's station with medical charts and glass bottles stands in the foreground. Clean, sterile, and institutional atmosphere with white-washed walls.

The dusty, neglected interior of Carfax Abbey. A stone hall leads to a low, arched oaken door. Inside the chapel, heavy layers of dust cover the floor and hang from walls like tattered rags. The air is stagnant and foul. Lit only by small electric lamps casting deep, dancing shadows against ancient masonry. Oppressive and decayed.

A rugged, snow-covered mountain pass in the Carpathians during the day. Gray heavy skies and falling snow. The landscape is wild and desolate, with jagged rocks and distant pine forests. A rough track winds through the valley. Cold, harsh, and grey.

A dingy, cramped lodging-house entrance in a poor district. The hallway is dim, smelling of stale beer and damp wood. Peeling paint covers the narrow walls. A single flickering gas jet casts long shadows over the battered doorframe. The mood is grimy and unwelcoming.

A private sitting room in the Hotel Odessus, Varna. The decor blends Victorian travel comforts with Eastern European rustic details. A heavy oak table is covered in maps and telegrams. A window looks out onto the grey, misty harbor of the Black Sea. The light is cool and diffuses through lace curtains. Atmosphere of tense waiting.

The captain's cabin of a merchant schooner. Dark wood panelling is stained with salt and tobacco smoke. Nautical charts are pinned to a table alongside a brass oil lamp. A porthole reveals the grey waters of the Danube river harbour. The space is utilitarian, masculine, and cluttered with shipping manifests.

A rugged mountain road winding through the Carpathian landscape at sunset. Green sloping hills are covered in orchards of white fruit blossoms. In the background, jagged pine-covered peaks turn deep purple and blue against a fading pink sky. The lighting is the golden-hour glow of early evening.

A vast library in the castle, walls lined with shelves of English books and bound magazines. A table in the center is littered with papers and periodicals. Lit by oil lamps, the room has a scholarly but ancient feel, with heavy curtains and comfortable but old furniture. No mirrors.

A luxurious Victorian drawing room filled with light. Plush velvet sofas, a marble fireplace, and elegant floral arrangements. Large windows draped in silk look out onto a garden. The mood is romantic and bright, with pastel colors and rich textures. A place of comfort and wealth.

The deck of a 19th-century schooner at sea, shrouded in thick grey fog. Wet wooden planks and rigging are dimly lit by a swaying oil lantern. The atmosphere is claustrophobic and damp. Shadows loom in the mist. Muted grey and sickly yellow tones.

A dramatic Victorian seaside cliff top at night, lashed by a violent storm. In the foreground, wet grass and gravestones of the churchyard glisten in flashes of lightning. Below, the dark, churning North Sea smashes against the harbour piers. The beam of a searchlight cuts through heavy rain and sea-fog. Cold blues, greys, and stark white highlights.

A grassy churchyard on a high cliff overlooking a Victorian harbour. Ancient weathered tombstones lean at odd angles. In the background, the immense, noble ruins of Whitby Abbey stand against a bright sky. Below, red-roofed houses pile up towards the water. Bright, breezy seaside atmosphere.

The Whitby cliffside shrouded in heavy grey mist and storm clouds. The sea below is a tumult of grey water and white foam. The Abbey ruins loom darkly in the fog. The atmosphere is ominous, oppressive, and dim, lit only by a diffused, sun-burst grey light.

scenes.location_header: INT/EXT. CASTLE DRACULA - BEDROOM WINDOW - NIGHT
scenes.visual_description: A stone-mullioned window in a castle bedroom looking out over a vast abyss. Moonlight bathes the weathered stonework and the precipice dropping away into darkness. The walls are rough stone, ancient and formidable.

A dusty suite of rooms in an older wing of the castle. Moonlight floods through diamond-paned windows, illuminating heavy, moth-eaten furniture that once spoke of comfort. The air is still and thick with the dust of centuries. A large couch sits near a corner.

scenes.location_header: INT. CASTLE DRACULA - CHAPEL VAULT - DAY
scenes.visual_description: A ruined medieval chapel beneath the castle, heavy with the smell of turned earth. Broken vaulted ceilings reveal dark stonework. The floor is dug up, with piles of earth and fifty great wooden boxes arranged in the gloom. An arched stone passage leads to a circular stair. Lit only by a lantern, shadows are deep and menacing.

An active construction site in Poplar for a new cold storage building. Scaffolding surrounds rising brick walls. Piles of materials and machinery clutter the ground. The air is filled with dust and the noise of industry. Flat, grey daylight washes over the utilitarian structures.

A guest room in the asylum repurposed as a workspace. An iron bed is covered with maps and railroad timetables. A travel trunk sits open, revealing medical equipment and religious artifacts. Sunlight struggles through a single sash window. Utilitarian, cluttered, and temporary.

The deck of a small steam launch on a river at night. The open door of the furnace casts a fierce orange glow on the metal fixtures and the swirling dark water beyond the gunwales. Wisps of steam and smoke trail into the darkness. The mood is adventurous, cold, and industrial.

A bedroom transformed into a chapelle ardente. Tall wax candles burn steadily, casting a soft golden glow over masses of white flowers. In the centre, a coffin rests, the face covered by a winding sheet. The room is still, beautiful, and heavy with the scent of lilies.

A breakfast room at Hillingham, lighter and less cheerless than the rest of the house. The blinds are up, admitting afternoon light. A table is set for a meal. The atmosphere is tense but functional, a brief respite from the gloom.

A dark, narrow mountain pass shrouded in gloom and mist. Towering jagged rocks and dense pine forests loom on either side, creating a tunnel-like effect. The scene is lit only by moonlight breaking through storm clouds and the faint glow of carriage lamps on snow-dusted ground.

A dusty, chaotic carrier's yard in London. Horse-drawn wagons are being loaded with crates. The air is thick with floating dust and the smell of horses. Piles of wooden boxes and shipping invoices clutter the foreground. The lighting is flat, utilitarian daylight. Industrial and gritty.

scenes.location_header: INT. MITCHELL SONS AND CANDY - AFTERNOON
scenes.visual_description: A stiff, formal office in Sackville Street. High mahogany desks and leather chairs create an air of exclusivity. Everything is meticulously organized and polished. The light is subdued and serious, filtering through heavy blinds. The atmosphere is professional, quiet, and slightly condescending.

A small, cluttered keeper's cottage at the London Zoo. A simple wooden table is set for tea. A fireplace warms the room. Animal cages are visible through the window. The atmosphere is working-class and domestic.

A quiet, well-furnished corridor in a grand Victorian manor. Flocked wallpaper in muted tones, polished wooden floorboards with runners. Gas sconces provide low, steady light. Several panelled wooden doors lead to bedrooms. An atmosphere of hushed anxiety.

A natural shallow cave or hollow protected by boulders, high up on a snowy mountainside. Looking out, the view drops away to a river valley below, with the grim silhouette of Castle Dracula visible on a distant precipice. Snow swirls in the air. Cold, grey light of late afternoon turning to sunset.

A comfortable private room, perhaps in a club or hotel. Leather armchairs, a side table with a decanter of whiskey, and travel mementos. The atmosphere is masculine and warm, with the glow of a fire or lamp.

A comfortable Victorian guest bedroom. A fire burns low in the grate, casting flickering orange light on floral wallpaper and a plush armchair. A washstand with a ceramic pitcher sits in the corner. The atmosphere is intimate and weary.

A view from the castle parapets looking out over a sea of green treetops and deep gorges. Steep, jagged cliffs drop away thousands of feet. Silver threads of rivers wind through the forest below. The view is magnificent but terrifyingly high.

The overgrown exterior of a deserted chapel at night. A massive, iron-bound oak door stands shut within a high stone archway. Weeds and ivy choke the rough masonry. Moonlight struggles through dense trees, casting erratic shadows on the damp ground. An atmosphere of decay and ancient secrets.

The grounds of a Victorian asylum. A driveway leads to a large empty house next door. A carrier's cart stands on the gravel. High walls and iron gates surround the area. The atmosphere is volatile and public.

Lucy's bedroom at night, lit by dim gaslight and moonlight filtering through the blinds. The garlic flowers are prominent. Shadows are deep and long. The room feels claustrophobic and charged with supernatural dread.

A fashionable London street lined with high-end shops and clubs. A victoria carriage waits near the curb. Crowds of well-dressed Londoners move past shop windows displaying luxury goods. The architecture is grand and imposing.

An upscale hotel writing desk area. Stationery with the hotel crest, an oil lamp burning low, and a glass of brandy. The background suggests a well-furnished private suite in London. Serious and quiet.

A cluttered academic study in Amsterdam. Books piled high, medical instruments, scattered papers. Heavy wooden furniture, tobacco smoke hanging in the air. Warm lamp light against dark wood. Intellectual and chaotic.

A wild, overgrown section of Hampstead Heath at dusk. Gorse bushes and furze cast long, jagged shadows. The sky is a bruising purple and grey. A distant path winds through the gloom. Mysterious and slightly menacing.
